# Third-party licenses

The licenses of the third-party code that `om`, device identity and Core link or ship.
`scripts/check_licenses.py` writes the list below and fails on any license it does not
allow. This repository's own modules, such as the network library, are not listed. The
bundle's Python runtime is the python-build-standalone archive the release owner passes to
`scripts/build_bundle.py`.
`om`'s Try page embeds the Inter font under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, in
[daemon/inter-OFL.txt](daemon/inter-OFL.txt).
